reference.title: Python API reference
reference.intro: Import with from qui import ctx. instance_id is an integer; torrent_hash is a string. Access is restricted to selected active instances. Reads are allowed; writes require the listed permission. A None result acknowledges the call; query again to inspect subsequent state.
reference.contextBody: ctx.params: task JSON parameters; ctx.task_id: task ID; ctx.dry_run: preview flag. SDK errors raise RuntimeError. Dry runs perform real reads but skip client writes and notifications; later reads do not reflect simulated writes. Direct Python file/network operations are not protected by dry run. Times are Unix seconds; counters use bytes. 2 MiB/s = 2×1024×1024 B/s. Torrent mutations affect one hash; loop for batches. ctx.tracker_domains: domains selected in the tracker dropdown. Custom scripts must apply this filter themselves; the SDK does not enforce tracker scope.
reference.fieldsBody:
instance / instances: id (int), name (str), country_code (str), is_active (bool), has_local_filesystem_access (bool), daily_traffic_enabled (bool). Credentials and client URLs are not exposed.

torrent / torrents: hash, name, category, tags (comma-separated string), state (qBittorrent state string), save_path, content_path; added_on, completion_on, last_activity (Unix seconds); size (selected size), total_size (entire torrent), amount_left, uploaded, downloaded (bytes); upspeed, dlspeed, up_limit, dl_limit (B/s); progress (0–1), ratio (client upload/download ratio), seeding_time, time_active (seconds), num_seeds, num_leechs (connected peers); tracker_hosts (list[str]), trackers_complete (bool). If trackers_complete is false, use trackers(). Values such as -1 retain the client's unknown/unlimited sentinel semantics.

transfer: connection_status, dht_nodes, dl_info_data, up_info_data (bytes), dl_info_speed, up_info_speed, dl_rate_limit, up_rate_limit (B/s).

properties: addition_date, completion_date, creation_date, last_seen (Unix seconds); total_size, total_uploaded, total_downloaded, total_uploaded_session, total_downloaded_session, total_wasted, piece_size (bytes); up_speed, dl_speed, up_speed_avg, dl_speed_avg, up_limit, dl_limit (B/s); share_ratio, seeding_time, time_elapsed, eta, reannounce (seconds except share_ratio); pieces_have, pieces_num, nb_connections, nb_connections_limit, peers, peers_total, seeds, seeds_total; name, hash, infohash_v1, infohash_v2, save_path, download_path, comment, created_by, is_private. Some fields depend on client version.

files: index, name (torrent-relative path), size (bytes), progress (0–1), priority, availability, piece_range, is_seed (optional). categories: {name: {name, savePath}}. Empty collections may be None when supplied by an older client; iterate with “or []” / “or {}”.
reference.example: Example: instances, limits, tags and upload delta
reference.exampleHint: Requires limits and tags permissions. Dry-run first. Catching and suppressing errors leaves the run successful; raise at the end to mark it failed.

entries.description: Selected active instances; enable All instances on the task to enumerate every active client.
One selected instance. Metadata is captured at run start; no connection is required.
Fetch live client-wide transfer counters, speeds, limits and connection status. Counters follow qBittorrent semantics, not QUI daily history.
Fetch a fresh torrent list from the client. Filter the returned list in Python.
Fetch a fresh single-torrent snapshot. Missing torrents raise RuntimeError.
Fetch extended properties including average speeds, pieces and connections. Field names differ from torrent snapshots.
Get files through QUI's file cache. Not guaranteed to be a fresh snapshot.
Get deduplicated tracker hostnames only; no announce URLs or passkeys.
Categories keyed by name, each with name and savePath. May use QUI's cached metadata.
List instance tag definitions; may use QUI's cached metadata.
Set torrent upload limit. Nonnegative multiple of 1024 B/s; 0 removes the torrent limit.
Set torrent download limit using the same units as upload_limit.
Add a list of strings, preserving existing tags.
Remove the specified tags from this torrent only. An empty list is a no-op.
Replace all tags on this torrent; [] clears them. Requires qBittorrent 5.1+ / WebAPI 2.11.4+; older clients raise an error.
Create instance-wide tag definitions.
Delete tag definitions across the instance, affecting all torrents that use them.
Assign an existing category; an empty string clears the torrent category. Automatic management may move files.
Create an instance category. save_path is a path on the qBittorrent machine.
Change the existing category's save path, not its name. Automatic management may move files.
Delete a nonempty list of category definitions from the instance; does not delete torrents or files.
Pause or resume one torrent (mapped to stop/start on newer clients).
Request tracker reannounce. Completion means the request was accepted, not that the tracker credited traffic.
Request a torrent data recheck; it may interrupt transfer while checking.
Delete through QUI with traffic compensation. True also deletes files. There is no interactive confirmation in scripts.
Task-local persistent JSON state. Keys: 1–512 characters. None reads as the supplied default. Dry runs use an in-memory overlay.
Request an earlier next interval run using Unix seconds. Future timestamps only; earliest request wins. No exact-time guarantee; disabled/manual-only tasks are not enabled by this call.
Send through notification targets subscribed to automation actions. Dry run logs only.
Current Unix seconds / append text to the run log. Logs are capped at 256 KiB per run.

scripts.trackersHelp: Options come from torrents on the selected instances. A merged site selects all its domains. HDSKY requires a selection. Custom scripts read ctx.tracker_domains and implement their own filtering.
